Not imported: monero-fcmp-plus-plus and monero-fcmp-plus-plus-generators.
Those are Monero's Ed25519 wrapper and Monero generators. Shear does not use them.

Audit gap, recorded and not closed: helioselene point and encoding code, the ec-divisors library, and the upstream commits after the Veridise gadget audit are not a Shear audit. The audit PDFs are not redistributed. This tree is not wired into shear_admit. The live prover is still the 32-note path.
